pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "gave everyone a transparent, public way" adds an unrestricted everyone to a distribution mechanism governed by eligibility restrictions, though later eligibility conditions are retained.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "up for grabs in the final period" correctly conveys remaining available and "set to open straight after" retains scheduling rather than asserting actual opening.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "done and dusted", "have a squiz" and "out of the blue" sound natural rather than staged.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "spread FOLD a bit wider", "put their bids in" and "up for grabs" give moderate level-3 connecting prose without altering protected terms.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "Only use auction, claiming, verification, and support links" keeps the safety instruction firm, and the original no-advice statement remains.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "whichever is higher: the original floor price or" makes the price mechanism easy to follow aloud.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "up and running", "done and dusted" and "take the sting out" vary the local language across the long FAQ.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "Claiming and general FOLD transferability are two separate things." preserves the FAQ’s central distinction, chronology and safety emphasis.

current.meaning: "The aim was to spread distribution further" retains purpose, while "50% of proceeds were committed" preserves commitment and all thresholds, dates and functions remain.
current.sense: "Claiming was due to open as soon as the auction closed." preserves the scheduled opening and "whichever is higher" preserves the price floor logic.
current.authenticity: "gives you the good oil", "had wrapped up" and "have a squiz" are credible local idioms.
current.register: "put their bids in", "off the ground" and "There’s no telling" give an appropriately moderate level-3 voice to eligible prose.
current.tone: "Getting through verification wasn’t a guarantee of eligibility or an allocation." keeps the qualification firm; safety and no-advice warnings retain force.
current.flow: "Claiming is one action; general FOLD transferability is another." is concise and easy to read aloud.
current.variety: "good oil", "wrapped up", "kicked in" and "cough up" vary the language without repetitive filler.
current.essence: "The minimum price may go up in later periods. It doesn’t drop below" preserves the unusual auction mechanics and the full FAQ structure.

dinkum-3.meaning: "Getting through verification didn't guarantee you eligibility or an allocation" retains the key limitation; exact dates, amounts, timestamps and claim distinction remain.
dinkum-3.sense: "50% of proceeds were locked in" can suggest actual locking of funds, stronger and more technical than a commitment to support.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "done and dusted", "got in on" and "a leg-up" are natural local constructions.
dinkum-3.register: "Nah, nah.", "mind." and "Not ever." add performed emphasis and tails beyond the empty-garnish contract, although the body has ample level-3 voice.
dinkum-3.tone: "Stick to auction, claiming, verification, and support links" and "and only those." preserve a firm safety instruction; the no-advice provision remains clear.
dinkum-3.flow: "For each following period, the minimum price is whichever's higher" turns the technical condition into smooth speech.
dinkum-3.variety: "a leg-up", "up for grabs" and "jumping in" give a varied vocabulary.
dinkum-3.essence: "Claiming and general FOLD transferability are two different things." keeps the central distinction, while headings, chronology and disclaimer structure remain recognisable.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: gave everyone a transparent, public way
pre-fix-yarn.why: Everyone overgeneralises access in a document where participation is explicitly restricted; later eligibility text limits but does not justify the added universal.

dinkum-3.quote: 50% of proceeds were locked in for long-term on-chain liquidity support.
dinkum-3.original: 50% of proceeds were committed to long-term on-chain liquidity support.
dinkum-3.why: Locked in can imply a fund-locking mechanism rather than the stated allocation commitment; technical financial prose needs the precise commitment sense.
Adds a separate emphatic tail despite empty garnish; mind and Nah, nah similarly introduce a small amount of performed emphasis.

summaries.pre-fix-yarn: Natural moderate vernacular with the mechanics intact; one unnecessary universal blurs restricted access.
summaries.current: Precise, fluent and naturally moderate; conditions, technical distinctions and warning force survive.
summaries.dinkum-3: Fluent and complete, with an imprecise commitment expression and a little prohibited emphatic garnish.
